content: Do not change the brand of this medication without consulting your doctor first. If you are being treated for an HIV infection, it is essential to use the higher-strength dosage of this medication as prescribed. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Different brands of this medication may have specific storage requirements. Refer to the product packaging for detailed storage instructions or consult your pharmacist for guidance. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal regulations. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. It is important to note that this summary does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific condition. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this medication and your individual health needs.
